name: menubar
useFor: Use for an app-style menu of commands in a dense tool, such as an editor for an agent's notes. In the console's pages prefer buttons and row menus.
constraints: A menubar for site navigation (use Navigation Menu)
source: Extrapolated from the Inkbox console (Figma 427:2715): the tab track (Mailboxes, Contact rules, Custom domains) and the raised panel
